entries.3e9b9c7dce41cae9: Under its 13th Medium-Term Management Plan, starting in fiscal 2026, and its business policy of 'Second Founding: Toward New Value Creation, Opening the Future,' the company states that it will advance a transformation of its business structure and strengthen its management foundation. For the two-wheel business, the plan calls for an all-around response to global markets to secure share in its core business and build a foundation for the shift to electrification; for the four-wheel business, a flexible production structure responding to demand fluctuations and accelerated commercialization for EV/CASE; and for the environment and energy business (non-mobility area), product development that uses core technologies to contribute to decarbonization and energy creation.
